title: Agent Workspace Task
description: Machine-readable task contract for the autonomous agent contribution pipeline. Every file under tasks/backlog/ and tasks/completed/ MUST conform to this schema.

taskId.description: Globally unique task identifier. Matches the filename (minus .json) and the PR title prefix.

title.description: Short imperative title. Prefix with '[meta] ' for pipeline-improvement tasks.

objective.description: One to three paragraphs stating what 'done' means in human terms. An agent should be able to restate this without ambiguity.

inputs.description: The materials an agent needs to start: files to read, commands to run, resources to fetch.

paths.description: Repo-relative files/dirs the agent should read first. Empty array is allowed for greenfield tasks.

commands.description: Commands the agent should run to gather context (read-only by intent).

context.description: Prose explaining why these inputs matter and what to extract from them.

artifacts.description: Repo-relative paths the agent must create or modify.

spec.description: Detailed specification of the artifacts: interfaces, formats, invariants. May reference a file path containing the spec.

verificationTests.description: Acceptance tests. A PR is mergeable only when every entry here passes. Each entry maps a test id to how to run it.

id.description: Stable identifier surfaced in the CI eval comment's 'blocking' array on failure.

command.description: Shell command to run from repo root. Exit 0 == pass.

assert.description: For 'contains': a substring the command stdout must include. For 'json_match': a JSONPath/JSON value the output must contain.

benchmark.description: If true, this entry is a benchmark; the regressionThreshold governs acceptable change.

regressionThreshold.description: Max allowed fractional regression (e.g. 0.10 = 10% slower still passes). Only meaningful when benchmark=true.

priority.description: P0 critical > P1 high > P2 medium > P3 low. Agents claim the highest-priority open task first.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Backlog files are 'open' or 'in_progress'; completed/ files are 'completed'.

assignee.description: Agent identity that claimed the task. null/absent means unassigned. Claiming agents set this in their first commit.

dependsOn.description: taskIds that must reach 'completed' before this task can start.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 completion timestamp; set when moved to tasks/completed/.

prNumber.description: The GitHub PR number that closed this task.

memory.description: One to two lines the next agent in this area should know. Promoted from the PR's 'Memory for the next agent' section on merge.
